leave_mechanism_out.reason: No admitted independent Cout labels or reviewed field-derived mechanism groups.

Wave4 authored-family GP folds: same reduced-screen target lineage, no independent geometry/mechanism OOD.
Retained Wave4 OpenFOAM carrier/GCI pressure diagnostics: no closed dispersed-oil inventory or independently admitted Cout labels.
EV09 software test fixtures: synthetic oracle objects, no actual observations.
positive_checks: Reviewed measured label +12 same-identity measured feature slots admit in explicitly synthetic software fixture.
Both geometry-family and mechanism holdout partitions constructed in synthetic fixture; repeated geometry excluded across either boundary.
negative_checks: Geometry-only evidence cannot establish observed physical mechanism membership.
Single mechanism group and empty dataset cannot produce holdouts.
Submitted IndependentObservation status alone cannot create opaque admission authority.
Missing/OOD features abstain and route direct evaluation; absent fold metrics remain unavailable.

section6_handoff.heading: Independent oil-label dataset and geometry/mechanism holdouts
section6_handoff.text: The admission and disjoint-holdout software foundation is delivered. Real independently labelled surrogate training, OOD error and calibration remain deferred: no admitted independent Cout labels or reviewed observed-mechanism inventory exist. The authored-family screen summaries are sandbox diagnostics and cannot close this acceptance gate.

required_contents: Reviewed source-bound Cout observations in mg per litre of dispersed oil, with exact concentration basis, input duty, reject fraction, units, uncertainty components and applicability envelope.

Independent oil-grade observations from qualified full-residence, closed-inventory oil evaluation or independently validated measurements; carrier pressure diagnostics and prior-screen targets do not count as Cout labels.

Exact genome, IR, compiled geometry, surface/volume mesh or specimen, case, requirement, scenario, model, solver/build and data-source identities, plus live trusted evidence references and reviewer decisions.

Geometry-observed features and reviewed geometry-cluster/family membership; field-observed mechanism assignments with their own sources. Authored label or gene activation alone establishes neither geometry novelty nor an observed mechanism.

Independent preparation/replicate identifiers and grouping metadata needed to prevent replicate, near-duplicate-geometry and mechanism leakage. The replication design is preregistered from uncertainty/power analysis, not chosen to produce a desired result.

unblocking_holdouts: Freeze requirements, feature contract, label admission, geometry clustering, mechanism membership, metrics and uncertainty/coverage protocol before fitting; resolve every trusted evidence reference and revocation dependency.
Run leave-geometry-family-out folds with geometry clusters and independent preparations disjoint between train and test; no duplicate or near-duplicate subject may cross a fold.

Run leave-observed-mechanism-out folds using reviewed field-derived mechanism membership, with overlapping geometry/preparation groups excluded from training; do not substitute authored family names for mechanism observations.

Fit through fit_independent only after every fold meets the declared estimator and dataset sufficiency rules. Retain per-subject train/test membership, predictions, residuals and uncertainty intervals so another reviewer can recompute RMSE/MAE and interval coverage with uncertainty.

Publish a source-bound calibration table and failed/insufficient/OOD abstentions, including negative tests for prior-derived labels, missing observed features, leakage and revoked sources. Missing folds remain Insufficient; no zero-error fallback or claim promotion.
section6_handoff.next_owners: INT supplies/reviews independent data and preregistration; IR supplies observed geometry/field receipts and reviewed mechanism assignments; EV admits labels and executes disjoint OOD/calibration checks; DOC reports the resulting evidence tier.

sufficiency_note: Current software requires12 observed features, at least5 inventory samples and at least4 geometry-disjoint training samples per nonempty test fold, plus >=2 observed groups of each kind. These are code preconditions, not a validated statistical sample-size or physical admissibility limit; preregister dataset sufficiency from uncertainty/power analysis.
no_fabrication: No labels, mechanism memberships, held-out errors or coverage values were invented. Unavailable metrics remain null.
next_dependency: INT delivers reviewed source-bound independent oil dataset/preregistration; IR delivers independently observed features, geometry-group and field-derived mechanism receipts; EV admits live sources and executes both disjoint holdout families; DOC records section6 blocker.
